name: Signal Jammer - DMG UP
RelatedDescription: Unceasingly emits EM waves to suppressively interfere with projectiles and disrupt electronic equipment, thus weakening the power of tactical weapons. It can also inflict a DMG Taken UP effect on the enemy.
